description: Mutual reverts (spec 5, the comparison query; DATA_MODEL.md section 7): editor a reverted b AND b reverted a on the SAME page. Input: history revert_links with within_followup and by_other (both keys not null). $group makes the triples (reverter_key, author_key, page_id) with the distinct reverting revisions; a self-$lookup on revert_links (same page, roles swapped) finds the reverse direction. One row per page and unordered pair (a < b by key): page_id, a, b, a_reverted_b and b_reverted_a (distinct revert actions in each direction). Ordered by page_id, a, b. The output shows editor keys: results/ files replace human keys with pseudonyms. How to run it by hand: in Atlas, open Data Explorer, pick the database 'truthlag' and the collection 'revert_links', open the Aggregations tab, switch to the text view (the '</>' button) and paste the 'pipeline' array. In MongoDB Compass: open the collection 'revert_links', Aggregations, Text, then paste the array. In mongosh: db.revert_links.aggregate(<pipeline>). Do not edit this file by hand: queries/run_mongo.py writes it from config.py.
